Returns the office-managed assessment configuration, active blackout dates, and the America/New_York operating timezone. Owner, manager, and dispatch roles only.

403.description: Owner, manager, or dispatch role required

post.description: Updates the configured weekly assessment windows using an optimistic version. Saving cancels unbooked future generated slots; booked appointments are retained.

403.description: Owner, manager, or dispatch role required

post.description: Generates slots from configured weekly availability for one through 90 calendar days. Existing bookings, blackouts, daylight-saving transitions, and travel buffers are preserved.

400.description: Invalid date range or a range outside one through 90 days

403.description: Owner, manager, or dispatch role required

post.description: Adds an office blackout. It cannot overlap a booked assessment, including configured travel buffers.

403.description: Owner, manager, or dispatch role required

post.description: Archives an active assessment blackout. It does not restore cancelled slots automatically.

403.description: Owner, manager, or dispatch role required

get.description: Returns up to 100 future, unbooked slots outside active blackouts. Office roles and invited clients may read availability; clients still need office confirmation for non-assessment services.

post.description: Creates a future manual assessment appointment, subject to blackout and buffered-slot collision checks. Owner, manager, and dispatch roles only.

403.description: Owner, manager, or dispatch role required

post.description: Atomically reserves an available assessment slot for an accessible operational property. Repeated racing attempts result in one success and a conflict response; the booking does not create a work order or invoice.

get.description: Lists active and archived contacts for a client. Owner, manager, dispatch, sales, and finance roles only; client and crew accounts cannot read another client's contacts.

post.description: Creates an additional primary, billing, site, or other client contact and writes an audit record. Contact identity is kept distinct from dashboard login identities.
Updates or archives a contact using its current version. A stale or cross-client update fails and does not overwrite contact history.

409.description: Contact changed or is unavailable; refresh before saving

get.description: Returns manager-only configuration indicators and the current office action queue. It does not expose provider credentials, trigger provider calls, post invoices, or change delivery state.

Office roles receive operational service requests with submitting identity. Clients receive requests for accessible properties, but never the internal submitting user ID. This endpoint does not change request status or dispatch work.

WorkOrder.description: Authorized work projection. Clients receive only identity, property name, title, scheduled_at and public status; operational fields are absent, not null placeholders.

raw_intake.description: Validated version1 Core intake event. Business content remains untrusted.

assignedTo.description: Omit to retain assignment; null explicitly unassigns.

override_reason.description: Accepted requirement edits clear the previous override.

mfaRequired.description: Whether this account is required to complete MFA before protected dashboard access.

day.description: Day of week, where 0 is Sunday and 6 is Saturday.

user_id.description: Submitting staff identity; omitted from client responses.
Operational submitter identity. Omitted from client responses.

status.description: Current workflow status. Clients must not infer dispatch or billing completion from this value.

acreage.description: PostgreSQL numeric wire representation; do not coerce missing to zero

payload.description: Stored JSONB; shared field-event payload describes current writes, avoid narrowing historical reads without evidence

ServiceAgreementTerms.description: Finite term of at most120 calendar months. Monthly periods must exactly partition the term in calendar-month order with explicit partial-period amounts and null unitAmountCents. Per-visit terms require a rate and an empty period list. Server cross-field validation is authoritative.
